title: Worker scheduling and queue operations lack leader election, per-kind controls and long-job heartbeat

original_titles.title: No scheduler leader lock; auto-submit scan runs unguarded on every worker
Job queue: no dedupe_key, lease/heartbeat and backoff deviate from spec
No lease renewal for long jobs; dead letters only visible via admin endpoint
12+ job kinds missing; no advisory-lock scheduler
CI lacks backend type-check and an image/digest release path
Request timeout not enforced in the API pipeline
Job kinds share one retry policy; no jitter, no per-kind metrics

problem: worker.py invokes the auto-submit scan in every worker loop. The DB job queue has leases and retry backoff, but there is no leader lock for singleton scheduler scans, no lease renewal/heartbeat for long-running jobs and retry policy is largely shared across job kinds.
impact: Running multiple workers can perform duplicated expensive scans and potentially race on scheduled operations; long jobs may be reclaimed while still executing if they exceed the lease. Operational diagnosis is weak without per-kind metrics.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Separate singleton scheduling from parallel job execution. Acquire a PostgreSQL advisory lock or scheduler_leases row before scanning deadlines; only the elected scheduler runs the scan.
Add heartbeat/lease renewal for jobs expected to run longer than the initial lease. Workers must stop processing if they lose ownership.
Configure retry policy per job kind: attempts, backoff, jitter, timeout, retryable/non-retryable error classes and dead-letter handling.
Add dedupe keys for schedule-triggered jobs and preserve idempotency keys for scoring/release jobs.
Expose queue age, attempts, lease expiry, dead-letter count and handler latency by job kind; add tests with two workers and a deliberately long job.

acceptance_criteria: Only one scheduler runs a singleton scan at a time.
A long-running job renews its lease or is safely stopped before another worker reclaims it.
Retries do not duplicate scoring or event transitions.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
